verdict.rationale: Segment documents a Public API for managing workspace resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans with full CRUD. It also documents API-token authentication, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, rate limits and versioning, which together allow headless, scriptable control of the product. There is no evidence of a CLI or of documented CI/CD pipeline usage, so the CI part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/CD integration (e.g. tracking-plan or config-as-code in pipelines), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Segment Public API helps you manage your Segment Workspaces and its resources. You can use the API to perform CRUD (create, read, update, delete) operations at workspace scope
Authenticating requests — Create an API token
This includes working with resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans
